title: Singlife Davao Marathon 2026 Review: RUNRIO's Mindanao Flagship
seo_title: Singlife Davao Marathon 2026 Review | Mindanao Philippines
meta_description: Singlife Davao Marathon 2026: August 15 at SM City Lanang, Davao. RUNRIO-produced, Singlife-backed — Mindanao's premier marathon reviewed.
dek: Set for 15 August 2026 at SM City Lanang in Davao City, this RUNRIO-produced, Singlife-backed marathon is Mindanao's flagship road race. Four distances.
verdict: The Singlife Davao Marathon is Mindanao's premier marathon — a RUNRIO-produced, Singlife insurance-backed race at SM City Lanang in Davao City, the 'Durian Capital' of the Philippines. RUNRIO's gold-standard production ensures professional timing and race-day operations. Davao is Mindanao's largest city and a major destination in its own right — Mount Apo, the Philippine Eagle Centre, and some of the best fruit in the country. August in Davao is relatively dry. A top-tier Philippine marathon on the country's southern island.

sections.heading: RUNRIO Brings Gold Standard to Davao
paragraphs: RUNRIO's production at SM City Lanang — Davao's premier shopping complex — means professional timing, well-stocked aid stations, and a proven race-day template. [1] Singlife's insurance branding adds commercial credibility. Davao in August is relatively dry by Mindanao standards.

paragraphs: RUNRIO's Mindanao flagship marathon. 15 August 2026 at SM City Lanang, Davao. [1]

faqs.question: When is Singlife Davao Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: 15 August 2026 at SM City Lanang, Davao City. It offers 42.2K, 21.1K, 10K, and 5K. Registration is currently open. RUNRIO Inc. organises the event. Mark it on your calendar if you're planning your racing year around it. [1]
